name: Triac Advanced Anti Acne Face Wash | Deep Cleansing Facial Wash for Acne-Prone Skin | 70ml
description:
Keep your skin feeling fresh and thoroughly cleansed with Triac Advanced Anti Acne Face Wash. This facial cleanser is formulated for acne-prone skin and is designed to remove daily impurities, excess oil, and buildup while cleansing the skin. The face wash creates a gentle lather when massaged onto wet skin, making it convenient for everyday facial cleansing. It can be incorporated into your skincare routine as directed by your dermatologist or physician.

Key Features
Advanced Anti-Acne Face Wash – Specially formulated for acne-prone skin and daily facial cleansing.
Deep Cleansing – Helps cleanse the skin and remove accumulated dirt, oil, and impurities.
Gentle Foaming Formula – Produces a lather when massaged onto moist skin.
Skin-Smoothing Care – Designed to leave the skin feeling clean and refreshed after washing.
Daily Skincare Support – Can be used as part of a regular facial cleansing routine.
Dermatologist/Physician Directed Use – The packaging recommends use twice daily or according to the direction of a dermatologist or physician.

Active Ingredients
Salicylic Acid
Mandelic Acid
Tea Tree Oil
Pyridoxine B6
Oleic Acid
NDGA

Directions for Use
Apply a suitable amount to moist skin.
Massage gently until a light lather forms.
Rinse thoroughly with water.
Use twice daily or as directed by your dermatologist or physician.

Safety Information
For external use only.
Avoid direct contact with the eyes.
Keep away from excessive sunlight and store according to the product packaging instructions.
If irritation or discomfort occurs, discontinue use.
Use according to the directions provided by your dermatologist or physician.
Keep out of reach of children.

Product Specifications
Product Name: Triac Advanced Anti Acne Face Wash
Product Type: Anti-Acne Facial Cleanser
Recommended Skin Concern: Acne-prone / blemish-prone skin
Formula: Foaming face wash
Usage: Facial cleansing

Package Includes
1 × Triac Advanced Anti Acne Face Wash
